about: The local gates' set (briefs/gate-tools-from-main.md): the files a copy of main holds, at their paths in the repository, so that their imports and loads resolve inside the copy; the remote whose main a copy comes from; and the version of the interface between the stable entries (tools/gate-entries/) and a copy. The set is the load closure of cargo's runner (tools/capped.mjs), git's pre-push hook (tools/git-hooks/pre-push) and the refresher (tools/gates.mjs). A test of tools/push.test.mjs reads every file of the set, its imports and the files it loads by path, and fails when one lies outside the set or is not a blob of mode 100644 or 100755.
